channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK Rangers train for NATO spec ops leadership role
item.description: British Army Rangers have carried out a major training exercise on Northumberland moorland as the UK prepares to take over a NATO special operations leadership role from July. The post UK Rangers train for NATO spec ops leadership role first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain urged to turn whole-of-society talk into action
item.description: A leading military historian has warned MPs that the UK remains far behind Nordic allies in preparing society for the demands of modern conflict, arguing that government has failed to translate years of discussion about resilience into practical planning for mass mobilisation. The post Britain urged to turn whole-of-society talk into action first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO warships hunt submarines off Norway in drill
item.description: NATO and Norwegian naval forces have begun Exercise Arctic Dolphin 26 off western Norway, bringing together Allied surface ships, submarines and maritime aircraft for two weeks of intensive anti-submarine warfare training in Arctic conditions. The post NATO warships hunt submarines off Norway in drill first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: More details emerge on Saab-Babcock frigate offer to Sweden
item.description: The vessel design being pitched for Lulea is described as a 124-metre frigate with a steel hull and lightweight composite superstructure, with a displacement of around 4,650 tonnes. The post More details emerge on Saab-Babcock frigate offer to Sweden first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Lockheed reveals Lamprey sub drone carrier concept
item.description: Lamprey could include payloads ranging from anti-submarine torpedoes to UAV launchers, indicating the system could potentially act as an underwater carrier for deploying other effects or platforms. The post Lockheed reveals Lamprey sub drone carrier concept first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO corps chiefs set 2026 focus on year of execution
item.description: Senior army corps commanders from across NATO met in Izmir, Turkey, in late January to align planning and training priorities for 2026 as the Alliance moves to operationalise its regional defence plans. The post NATO corps chiefs set 2026 focus on year of execution first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British and NATO aircraft gather intel on Russian forces
item.description: NATO and the United Kingdom have carried out a routine, visible intelligence-gathering presence over the Black Sea in recent hours, with surveillance aircraft operating at the same time on opposite sides of the Black Sea The post British and NATO aircraft gather intel on Russian forces first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: QinetiQ upgrades Diamond DA62 aircraft with new ISR kit
item.description: QinetiQ GmbH has successfully integrated an upgraded surveillance and communications package onto the Diamond Aircraft DA62 Multi-Purpose Platform. The post QinetiQ upgrades Diamond DA62 aircraft with new ISR kit first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Harpoon upgrade clears final U.S. Navy flight test milestone
item.description: The U.S. Navy has completed the final planned flight test of the Harpoon Block II Update (HIIU) Obsolescence Update programme, a key step in efforts to modernise and sustain the long-serving anti-ship missile. The post Harpoon upgrade clears final U.S. Navy flight test milestone first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: New Scottish ferry in dramatic rescue off African coast
item.description: The MV Isle of Islay carried out an unexpected rescue off the coast of Morocco during its delivery voyage to Scotland, with CalMac saying the crew saved an individual from dangerous sea conditions within minutes. The post New Scottish ferry in dramatic rescue off African coast first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
